It was a bare directory reached through a tsconfig path alias, which is fine while everything builds from this tree and fails the moment @mica/sdk ships as a tarball -- sdk/types.ts re-exports from here and is `export *`'d from both barrels, so these names are inside the SDK's published type surface, not an implementation detail. Consumed as source, exactly like @mica/sdk: no build step, no `main`, and the wildcard `exports` maps @mica/shared/<name> onto <name>.ts.
